question: In Linear: Add the comment 'Design approved.' to the 'Landing page refresh' issue with the 'Homepage mockup' attachment from Figma uploaded by Maya Chen.
final:
Done. ✅

- **Issue:** WEB-1 — Landing page refresh (the one whose "Homepage mockup" attachment came from Figma, uploaded by Maya Chen — WEB-2/WEB-3/WEB-4 have same-named issues but their mockups came from GitHub or were by Leo Park)
- **Comment:** "Design approved." with the Homepage mockup (`https://files.example/1.png`) embedded
- **Link:** https://linear.app/comment/8d624632-43ec-4e84-aa00-c0aaf90c7857

Note: Linear's `commentCreate` API doesn't take an attachment ID directly, so the Figma-sourced file was embedded by referencing its URL in the comment body — that's how Linear attaches existing files to comments.
